title: Run a five-node Engineering Graph (agent + function + gate + join) to passed
task: Engineering Graph control plane: one Agent node repairs the fixture, then function, gate, and join nodes settle in dependency order.

nodes.task: `npm test` fails in this project. `slugify` in src/slugify.js must lowercase the title, collapse every run of non-alphanumeric characters into a single "-", and trim leading and trailing "-". Fix src/slugify.js so all three tests pass. Do NOT edit anything under test/. Run `npm test` to verify.

notes: Drives core's real runEngineeringGraph with the same deterministic noop/collect handler registry the CLI and Server expose. The gate is crossed by an explicit approvedNodeIds selection on the first invocation, so a graph that silently auto-approves would still pass its status check but verify-graph.mjs pins the node kinds, the single Agent attempt, and the scheduler's dependency ordering from the durable checkpoint.
